table inet labfw { # handle 1
	counter dropped_to_site_b { # handle 3
		comment "packets dropped on the way into Site B"
		packets 0 bytes 0
	}

	chain forward { # handle 1
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		ip daddr 10.20.20.0/24 jump to_site_b # handle 4
	}

	chain to_site_b { # handle 2
		ip daddr 10.20.20.10 tcp dport 5432 counter packets 3 bytes 180 drop comment "CHG-1042 temporary block" # handle 14
		ct state established,related accept # handle 5
		ct state invalid drop # handle 6
		icmp type { echo-reply, destination-unreachable, echo-request, time-exceeded } accept comment "ping and traceroute replies" # handle 8
		udp dport 33434-33534 accept comment "traceroute probes" # handle 9
		ip saddr 10.10.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.20.20.10 tcp dport 5432 counter packets 4 bytes 240 accept comment "site A -> PostgreSQL (TLS)" # handle 10
		ip saddr 10.10.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.20.20.20 tcp dport 8200 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "site A -> KMS API (TLS)" # handle 11
		ip saddr 10.10.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.20.20.30 tcp dport 8443 counter packets 2 bytes 120 accept comment "site A -> app (HTTPS)" # handle 12
		counter name "dropped_to_site_b" drop # handle 13
	}
}
